dataset: Eurostat Census 2021: Dwellings by type of building, number of occupants and NUTS 3 region
source_institution: Eurostat; Belgian observations supplied through the harmonised Census 2021 programme
transformations: MFH equals two-dwelling plus three-or-more-dwelling residential buildings (RES2 + RES_GE3).
Exact 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5-person dwelling counts are retained.
The GE6 count is added to the five-person count because RichardsonPy supports at most five occupants; the resulting simulation category is labelled five-or-more.
Probabilities are dwelling counts divided by the corresponding SFH or MFH total.
license: Eurostat reuse policy; source dataset available through the official dissemination API
limitation: Building type is conditioned at the SFH/MFH level. Detached, semi-detached and terraced houses share the RES1 distribution; enclosed and exposed apartments share the combined RES2+RES_GE3 distribution.
